text:
devin: Heads-up — planning a gradual rollout for /v2/infer today at 10:00 PDT. Need volunteers for deploy owner, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Proposed ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~3 hours. Will run US West -> US East -> EU cohorts.

marta: I can own the deploy window and coordinator role. Will be on call for the first 2h.

ada: quick ask — any DB migrations or schema changes?

devin: no migrations. Just model swap + config toggle. Feature flag: `ff.infer.v2` (targeted rollout).

ada: ok. From infra side I want thresholds: abort if error rate > 1% for any 10m window or p95 latency > 500ms for 5m.

sam: I'll handle the actual rollout steps and execute the feature-flag ramp. I can run the following schedule script:```json
{"ramp": ["1%/30m", "5%/45m", "20%/45m", "100%/30m"], "cohorts": ["us-west", "us-east", "eu"], "health_checks": ["200s", "p95_latency", "error_rate"]}```

qa-jen: I'll run smoke tests at each step. Quick checklist: health endpoint, sample prompt sanity, cold-start latency, kv-cache hitrate sample. I can post results in this thread.

marta: who will be tagged for rollback if threshold tripped?

sam: tagging @marta and @devin as rollback approvers. Rollback command is `flagsunset ff.infer.v2 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer`, we have a rollback playbook in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/infra/rollbacks

ops-bot: Release job queued: release/2026-03-17-infer-v2 by sam. CI checks green. ETA 10:00 PDT. :rocket:

devin: small note — prefer 1% traffic slice to be internal-only (flagged test accounts) for the first 30m. Then open to cohorts. Keeps false negatives down.

ada: confirming capacity — this should not push GPU pool beyond 70% util; I've reserved burst capacity if needed.

qa-jen: I'll post pass/fail after each step. If I mark a smoke as fail, sam/marta act and we stop the ramp.

marta: plan sounds good. I'll monitor SLOs + error budget, sam execute, qa-jen validate, ada infra watch. Ping me 5m before kickoff.

devin: thanks all — pinging here so async folks can jump in. I'll update the rollout config and post the exact feature-flag targets before 09:45 PDT. :thumbsup:
